author: KEXP
description:
On her sophomore album 'Describe,' Hannah Jadagu pushes her sound forward with spellbinding arrangements and bold, pop-infused indie rock. Her latest in-studio session offers a performance of "Warning Sign" and more with host DJ Cheryl Waters.

Watch the full Live on KEXP session at the link in our bio.
title: Hannah Jadagu performs "Warning Sign" & more Live on KEXP
